# VC-HB-2800

Manufacturer: G&G.
Type code: 501-302-0515.
Description: 10B-2, 15 teeth, taper bush 1210.

URL: https://www.gg-powertransmission.com/fileadmin/cad/kettenraeder-klemmbuchsen/duplex/cad_501-302-0515.zip
File kept: `501-302-0515.stp` (520232 bytes).
The zip held only that STEP file.
The zip is not in the repository.
The file starts with `ISO-10303-21`.
Downloaded: 2026-11-19.
Terms: public direct download, no account.
Check the manufacturer's terms before redistributing this file.

`load_vendor_shape` recenters the bounding box and does not rotate the file.
The file bore axis is Z.
The chain shaft is Y.
`Rot(90, 0, 0)` maps the bore onto Y.
The oriented sprocket is about 82.72 × 25.50 × 82.27 mm.
The tooth tip is about 82.7 mm.
The published envelope tip is 83 mm.
The width is 25.5 mm.
The envelope width is 40 mm.
The drive sprocket is placed on the Ø30 shaft at the machine centre.
The exported solid is a faceted copy of this file.
The idler VC-HB-2810 reuses this solid.
It has no second file.
The chain strands still stop outside the 83 mm envelope, so they stay clear of the teeth.
No material sits inside a 19 mm radius along the bore.
The study shaft is Ø30 mm and passes that taper bore.
